suggestions.pitch: Smallest projected loss of the options, moving an aging Barkley and a stalled Waller for Mason and Daniels, and the partner is likely to accept.
Barkley is 29 and my window is low, so converting him into young Kaleb Johnson and Daniels is a rebuild-leaning deal with a good chance of acceptance.
Trades Barkley and Andrews for Spears and Daniels, which gives up points now but is very likely to be accepted.
